prompt: Create src/duration.py with exactly one public function parse_duration(value). It parses a duration string into whole seconds. Supported units: h, m, s. The test file must import the function exactly as `from src.duration import parse_duration`. Run pytest and make every test pass. Do not modify unrelated files.
